hook_text: Outputs 5, 9, 13, 17. The rule is hiding in the gaps. Find it in ten seconds.
clip_script: A number machine. Inputs 1, 2, 3, 4 go in. Outputs 5, 9, 13, 17 come out. What is the rule? Look at the jumps: 4, 4, 4. So the machine multiplies by 4. Check input 1: 1 times 4 is 4, but the output is 5. So after the times 4, it adds 1. Rule found: times 4 then plus 1. Test it everywhere: 2 times 4 plus 1 is 9. 3 times 4 plus 1 is 13. 4 times 4 plus 1 is 17. All true. Now run it backwards. Output 41? Take off 1: 40. Divide by 4: 10. Input was 10. Same rule three ways: in words, multiply by 4 and add 1; as a flow diagram, two boxes in a row; as a number sentence, 4 times box plus 1. The gaps give the multiplier. The first output gives the fix. Test every pair.
visual_style: Whiteboard machine with input and output slots; gaps between outputs highlighted as 4s; the rule boxes appearing; a backwards arrow undoing each box.
mood: Detective cracking a code, brisk and clear.
pacing: Gaps read fast, rule assembled, tested on all pairs, run backwards, then the three forms.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a number machine for a friend to crack.
